_note: v2.4 plan 01 T6 / X6, RED on the pre-T6 tree (no backend). A loud group generation that the player stops: ST's stopGeneration hides the stop button (ENDED) and then emits STOPPED (script.js:5607-5620), with no reply of the generation's own. The note it carried must stay ACCEPTED and ride the next loud generation, not be marked applied. Pre-T6 the note was marked applied at STARTED, so a stopped turn spent it and the next generation carried nothing.
